column1: # OpenDNA antibody dataset: the OAS data units this dataset is built from.
# Chosen by a stated rule (one unit per donor, spread across studies, within a size
# band), not by taste. OAS publishes no stable URL for its unit index, so this file is
# the catalogue and a change to it belongs in a reviewed diff.
